methodologyNotes: Covers freestanding charcoal kamado-style grills (thick-walled ceramic or heavily insulated steel, egg- or oval-bodied) sold at a published US price. Excludes gas grills, open charcoal kettles, pellet smokers, drum smokers, and pizza-only ovens. Price is typical US MSRP in USD for the standalone cooker in the trim noted per product. mainCookingAreaSqIn is the primary cooking-grate area in square inches. totalCookingAreaSqIn is the maximum cooking area with all included expander racks or tiers installed, in square inches; null when the grill ships single-tier. gridDiameterIn is the main cooking-grate diameter in inches (for oval bodies, the longest grate dimension). bodyMaterial is an enum: 'ceramic' or 'insulated-steel'. wallThicknessIn is the cooking-chamber wall thickness in inches; null when the maker does not disclose it. maxTempF is the manufacturer-stated maximum cooking temperature in degrees Fahrenheit. weightLbs is the assembled grill-body weight in pounds, excluding any cart or nest. includedCart is true when a nest, stand, or cart ships in the base price. sideShelvesIncluded is true when integrated side shelves or tables are included at the listed price. airLiftHinge is true when the lid uses a spring-assisted or counterweighted hinge. tieredRackSystem is true when the grill ships a multi-level divide-and-conquer tiered grate system. warrantyBodyYears is the warranty term on the ceramic or steel body in years; lifetime warranties are recorded as null and noted in the product provenance.
